what: Scarface Xbox functions that another Radical Entertainment Xbox game has too, byte for byte once the addresses in them are set aside (portal/tools/sibling_twins.py): shared engine code. Functions under 16 bytes and Microsoft's library functions are left out. `in` gives the function's address in each sibling's program (null when several functions there are the same). library_ids: Microsoft library functions a sibling's own `.XTLID` list numbers, found in Scarface by the same comparison; the numbers follow the order of the public Windows and Xbox headers, so a function between two named ones is the one declared between them. Leads to check, made from the founder's own copies of the games. No game bytes.
